result.evidence: At 0:02, the Anchor panel on the right side of the screen displays raw LaTeX code for several symbols (e.g., \mathbf{x}, \mathbf{z}_t, \boldsymbol{\epsilon}) instead of rendering them. This panel remains visible and broken across multiple parts of the lesson. At 6:12, in the '2.0 - Conventions (final)' section, the text 'If I copied Ho's \alpha_t into Prince's equation...' displays raw LaTeX code for \alpha_t. The interaction log notes a few instances of 'no visible change' (e.g., 0:28, 21:42), but these occur when clicking UI elements that are already in the selected state, which is expected behavior.

issues.description: The Anchor panel displays raw LaTeX code for symbols (e.g., \mathbf{x}, \mathbf{z}_t) instead of rendering them. This persists whenever the panel is visible.
The text under '2.0 - Conventions (final)' displays raw LaTeX code '\alpha_t' instead of the rendered symbol.

result.score_reason: The lesson has several major problems, specifically raw LaTeX code displayed instead of rendered content in multiple distinct locations (the persistent Anchor panel and the Conventions text).
